Primordial Trickster.name: Primordial Trickster
Primordial Trickster.description:
A sweet smell and the sound of giggles first announced the presence of your patron. Your patron is an entity that masks its true intentions with a whimsical mask. They might be an inscrutable fey, a smiling candy hag or some other scheming being from deep within the woods. You are likely unaware of your patron's true intentions, or what your role is in its game; but for now, the powers it gives you are truly wondrous.

Spell List primal

Patron Skill Nature

Lesson of Bewitching Lies You've seen first-hand what the honeyed words and candied gifts of your patron can accomplish, and it has eagerly shared its methods with you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.NVorc9c4ThpLtOCE]{Beguile} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rerNA6YZsdxuJYt3]{Déjà Vu}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.PI6xqyZ8o6kl9LUX]{Familiar of Entrancing Temptation}

Infinite Chorus.name: Infinite Chorus
Infinite Chorus.description:
The birth of sound may have been first, but music was the twin clasping its ankle. For a note can bend, so can it bend the emotions and feelings of those around it, sometimes even filling one with overwhelming sensations. It was this inevitable tune that entered your ear that your patron first gave you direction, flowing, and guiding as cliffs of sheet music. A satyr on panpipes, a lillend with their harp, or a melody on the wind from the plane of air; any could have taught you the harmony you know play. But thought the scale of your work can take many shapes, it is but the one, infinite song.

Spell List occult

Patron Skill Occultism

Lesson of Sculpted Harmonies Your patron has taught you how to shape the sounds of the world, using your magic as your instrument. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.Zs9oPQnZYDUd6n6m]{Cosmic Tune} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yV7Ouzaoe7DHLESI]{Ventriloquism}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.Uez6qnF2tiTMFLpx]{Familiar of Reprising Melody}

Silhouette of the Leviathan.name: Silhouette of the Leviathan
Silhouette of the Leviathan.description:
You made your pact with your patron out at sea, the domain of your new master. Perhaps it was during a terrible storm, where waves as tall as buildings threatened to drown you, or it might have been while exploring a submerged ruin to something long forgotten. It might take the shape of an aquatic wyrm, an ancient alghollthu or a wicked sea hag, but now, brine pulses through your veins like blood and the might of the sea is yours to control.

Spell List primal

Patron Skill Nature

Lesson of Crushing Currents Your patron has shown you that above all else, the sea is the mightiest force in the world. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.oA7qGKi5PQ0hAwzm]{Tidal Grasp} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jfVCuOpzC6mUrf6f]{Hydraulic Push}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.0Ai7ZSVNVIOHkCuI]{Familiar of Churning Saltwater}

Evershifting Entropy.name: Evershifting Entropy
Evershifting Entropy.description:
Wildly varying sensations overtook your body as you met your chaotic patron. Evidently, it seems to take glee in the unraveling of normalcy, and uses you as a pawn in doing so. Your patron could be some unknowable herald of pandemonium like a protean, a hundun, or something even more bizarre. Regardless of its true nature, the less you attempt to predict its whims, the greater your chances of learning from it.

Spell List arcane

Patron Skill Arcana

Lesson of Reason's Folly Your patron has proven how easily meaning and sense can crumple into nothing, and how this can be of great benefit to you. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.ju68drrYV8hQn2El]{Realityflicker} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r8g7oSumKOHDqJsd]{Agitate}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.mtc929TcevKfxYgG]{Familiar of Illogical Forms}

Mechanism of the Otherworldly.name: Mechanism of the Otherworldly
Mechanism of the Otherworldly.description:
The sound of clockwork ticking and the hiss of machinery overwhelmed you when you first stood before your patron. They are an entity of creation, and wish for you to combine magic and mechanics to further their inscrutable goal. They may be a resident of the Citadel of Resplendent Clockwork, the holy domain of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.deities.Item.vEMCpm7iidycRT5D]{Brigh}, or they might be an inevitable, a metal elemental, or an immensely powerful construct. Whatever their origin, they push you to innovate just as they do.

Spell List arcane

Patron Skill Crafting

Lesson of Schematic Analysis You have been taught schematics for marrying magic and clockwork. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.FM0Xu9ixPpOeRj2Z]{Conjure Gadget} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns the formula for one 1st-level common or uncommon gadget. When your familiar would learn new spells each time you gain a level, you can instead have it learn the formule for an uncommon or common gadget of your level or lower.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.7HZp8TrEV2wHolfH]{Familiar of Ticking Parts}

Special You gain access to the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.DQN7YC7s7T0pL6Aa]{Gadget Specialist} inventor class feat as a 6th level witch class feat, and lose access to the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-feats.Item.d8puGs28uZXv5Baa]{Ceremonial Knife} class feat. You can take inventor feats with Gadget Specialist as a prerequisite and subsequent feats as if you had a level in inventor equal to your witch level - 2.

The Great and Powerful Wishcrafter.name: The Great and Powerful Wishcrafter
The Great and Powerful Wishcrafter.description:
Your patron came to you when you made a wish, offering to make it come true... at a price. Genies, fiends, fey and more delight in offering wishes to mortals, and those with an exceptional sense of showmanship enjoy making witches of their wish-makers and sending them on an unknowable quest before granting their final, ultimate wish. By the end of your journey, you too will have granted many wishes—and corrupted far more.

Spell List arcane

Patron Skill Arcana

Lesson of Gleeful Loopholes Your patron has shown you that alternate interpretations of a straightforward request can have disasterous consequences. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.IgXLgysKIqYAdnnC]{Grant Wish} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vLA0q0WOK2YPuJs6]{Charm}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.sToq6b8DV1deSyHE]{Familiar of Desires Granted}

Spirit of Labyrinthine Roads.name: Spirit of Labyrinthine Roads
Spirit of Labyrinthine Roads.description:
You likely did not realize what your patron was when you first met them—an unfamiliar person at a bar, or a beggar on the road, perhaps? But once you made your pact with them, it became clear that they were either a great entity using the streets as a disguise, or perhaps a genius loci of the city itself. Now, the thrum of footsteps on pavement beats within your heart, and you hold the strange powers of an alley-witch.

Spell List arcane

Patron Skill Arcana

Lesson of Urban Isolation Your patron has shown you how to survive on your own in a busy settlement—something others can struggle to do. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.p5raHrW97ArzBadP]{Lost in the Crowd} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.iohRnd4gUCmJlh54]{Lose the Path}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.vJBcIkIhWREGILYd]{Familiar of Stumbling Steps}

Grasp of the Grave.name: Grasp of the Grave
Grasp of the Grave.description:
Maybe it was a drop in temperature that first heralded the presence of your patron, or a foul stench, or a shadow standing just behind you in the mirror. A lich? A vampire? A ghost? Or perhaps a psychopomp, intent on keeping the dead resting? Whatever your patron was once, it knows all about death—and if you listen carefully to its whispers, perhaps it can teach you its secrets.

Spell List divine

Patron Skill Religion

Lesson of Death's Transcendence Your patron shows you that death is not always the end. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.QQ17VS1dg0kPRpZE]{Spirit's Touch} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yHujiDQPdtXW797e]{Spirit Link}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.aA4IzWrW2E2JeuF8]{Familiar of Soul Consumption}

The Shambling Thing in the Mire.name: The Shambling Thing in the Mire
The Shambling Thing in the Mire.description:
You first encountered your patron in the depths of a bog, a swamp, or a marsh. Water as thick as mud, knotting branches blotting out the sky and the murky creatures that call the swamp their home are now as familiar to you as parchment to a traditional scholar. Your patron might be some amphibious or insectile monster worshiped as a god by denizens of the swamp, a mysterious bog mummy, a wretched sentient abomination, or something far stranger.

Spell List primal

Patron Skill Nature

Lesson of Creeping Moors Your patron has taught you how to spread its nature. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.yzfwpM0IldqOaLWH]{Swamp Emergence} hex cantrip and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yAiSNmz39qXOIlco]{Mud Pit}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.djd6TZqfcsPd4uHg]{Familiar of Murky Worlds}

Special If you take the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-feats.Item.OAKFEmT9z1Y6IGIH]{Witch's Armaments} class feat, you gain the following option instead of Living Hair:

  • Toad's Tongue Your tongue shoots from your mouth like a frog's.You gain an unarmed tongue attack that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage, is in the brawling group, and has the disarm, reach, and unarmed traits. Your tongue is capable of grabbing unattended objects of up to 1 Bulk within its reach.

The Ultimate Chain of Order.name: The Ultimate Chain of Order
The Ultimate Chain of Order.description:
Your patron revealed itself with a striking mantle of authority and voiced booming commands you had no choice but to obey. They enlightened you to the ultimate importance of order. It is an undefiable bond between things that must be to ensure the purity and sanctity of the universe. Your patron's origin is likely that of a vigilant warden of law; devils, aeons, archons, or even dragons of unbreakable code. The pact you made was rigorous, an unshakeable connection to fulfilling an expected duty. You are expected to follow it to the letter, and in doing so, you will gain unimaginable power.

Spell List divine

Patron Skill Religion

Lesson of Unbroken Code Your patron and you have an understanding that will not be broken by fickle means. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.4czsKd8LPYPQJ8NL]{Demand Compliance} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.B0FZLkoHsiRgw7gv]{Summon Lesser Servitor}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.rQOtPHWhk38SBs7B]{Familiar of Conflicting Authority}

Herald of Daylight's Touch.name: Herald of Daylight's Touch
Herald of Daylight's Touch.description:
Your patron shone bright when you first met, and filled you with the vital energy of the sun. Your magic is infused with the power of daylight, helping life to continue and pushing back the forces of darkness and despair. Your patron may have been an emissary of the god of the sun or another god of light, a powerful being from the birth of creation, or even the sun itself, rewarding you for your sun-worship. Now it is your task to spread daylight where it cannot go on its own.

Spell List divine

Patron Skill Religion

Lesson of Shining Rays Your patron teaches you of the sun's role as a gate to Creation's Forge, and of the struggle between vitality and void. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.KAWM4Ipy7ZBgZewv]{Aura of Violent Light} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.zEmYY8001YEtSvHf]{Familiar of Sunlit Dawn}

Raconteur of Never-Ending Tales.name: Raconteur of Never-Ending Tales
Raconteur of Never-Ending Tales.description:
You came across your patron in an old story book, some playing cards, or manifested in your memories of a fairy tale. Dreams, lies, history, and proverbs, what do they all share? Stories fill the voids between our understanding, and it is by stories that the world is shaped. Your patron may be a dream attempting to escape the astral plane, an intelligent storybook or harrow deck, or the guardian of lost scriptures of vital importance. Though the motives may vary, the story must be heard by those in need of its purpose.

Spell List occult

Patron Skill Occultism

Lesson of Anecdotal Propensity Your patron has educated you through stories, and in the power that even a simple proverb can hold. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.6NvV6OUs1kKsmO1W]{Famed Figure} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.1bDk3BxR8Ipwqgyd]{Familiar of Faraway Worlds}

Calamity Incarnate.name: Calamity Incarnate
Calamity Incarnate.description:
You saw your patron in the aftermath of a disaster, an avatar of destruction and calamity. Witches under patrons such as this take many forms, from pyromancers claimed by fire elementals or disaster cultists of the kaiju, to the guardians of vilalges plagued by monster attacks. Whether you are called to spread destruction or contain it, your magic contains the raw power of the being that gifted you your spells.

Spell List primal

Patron Skill Nature

Lesson of Rampant Devastation Understanding the destructive power of your patron comes only to those who witness it first hand, and you ensure that you do so often. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.wePHiiUSJa3xubHh]{Ravaging End} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.y6rAdMK6EFlV6U0t]{Breathe Fire}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.OdTctuvfYskyimD6]{Familiar of Armageddon's Favor}

Outsider in the Eternal Void.name: Outsider in the Eternal Void
Outsider in the Eternal Void.description:
Doom comes to those who look directly upon your patron, and you do not dare to do so yourself. Was it an aberrant visitor from the outer void? A shadow from Netherworld? Something worse? Perhaps you worship this horror from outside our reality, or maybe you feverishly study it in an attempt to repel it. One way or another, you've siphoned a fraction of its awful powers to empower yourself in pursuit of this goal.

Spell List occult

Patron Skill Occultism

Lesson of Settled Disconcertment Your patron has taught you to embrace uncomfortability and uncertainty, for adaptation is the truest virtue. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-focus-spells.Item.v8yeZZnni32IbnZn]{Lurking Doom} hex cantrip, and your familiar learns @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D442XMADp01qJ7Cs]{Mindlink}.

Unique Familiar Ability @UUID[Compendium.witches-remaster.witches-remaster-familiar-abilities.Item.OyRPlHK5kqgwqIg7]{Familiar of Disorienting Proximity}
